title: Laughter: An Essay on the Meaning of the Comic

publication.publisher_or_container: Macmillan and Co. (English translation); Project Gutenberg eBook 4352

verification.verification_notes: Public-domain English translation inspected directly. Verified the essay's account of laughter's social function and its requirement of 'absence of feeling' (indifference), and of 'mechanical inelasticity' as a source of the comic.

limitations: Claims about French rhythm and period-specific idiom are scoped to the translated text.

copyright.notes: Original (1900) and 1911 translation are in the public domain.
